g.text: +CPU(registers: RegisterFile, memory: Memory, alu: ALU, decoder: InstructionDecoder)
write(0x00, v) is redirected to Screen.write(v)
Execute opcodes 1-C. HALT sets halted = true.
Conditional jump B: if R[R] == R[0], PC = XY.
Opcode 4 (40RS): source R, destination = low nibble T
Opcode A (AR0X): rotate R right by X (getRotateCount()).
